title: Triggering Chain-of-Thought via Latent Feature Interventions in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2601.08058v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting often improves the reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs), but the internal signal that triggers this behavior remains poorly understood. Leveraging the sparse features captured by Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), we propose a systematic framework to analyze and intervene on the internal representations of LLMs, identifying a small set of latent features that are linked to reasoning behavior and can be causally tested through targeted intervention. Across multiple model families and reasoning benchmarks, we show that steering one or a small number of reasoning-related latent features can substantially induce reasoning behavior without explicit CoT prompting, achieving accuracy comparable to CoT. translated_title: 《通过潜在特征干预在大语言模型中触发思维链》
translated_abstract: 思维链提示通常能提升大语言模型的推理性能，但触发这一行为的内部信号仍鲜为人知。本文利用稀疏自编码器所捕获的稀疏特征，提出了一个系统性框架来分析和干预大语言模型的内部表示，识别出一小组与推理行为相关联的潜在特征，并可通过针对性干预对其进行因果检验。在多个模型家族和推理基准上的实验表明，仅调控一个或少数几个与推理相关的潜在特征，即可在无需显式思维链提示的情况下显著诱导出推理行为，其准确率可与思维链提示相当。研究进一步表明，所识别的特征并不与特定的措辞模式或冗长度绑定，并通过损害推理性能的抑制实验确认了这些特征在推理中的因果作用。
tldr: 该研究利用稀疏自编码器识别出大语言模型中与推理行为相关的潜在特征，并证明只需干预这些特征即可在无需显式思维链提示的情况下触发模型的推理行为，达到与思维链提示相当的准确率。
en_tdlr: This study identifies reasoning-related latent features in LLMs via sparse autoencoders and demonstrates that intervening on just one or a few of these features can induce reasoning behavior without explicit CoT prompting, achieving accuracy comparable to CoT.
